correctness.rationale: Reconstructing the 13-vertex Cayley graph yields 39 edges, 26 filled triangles, no K4, and a toroidal triangular-lattice universal cover with deck lattice L. The common-neighbour formula proves precisely 78 simple four-cycles; 39 are chorded and facially filled, leaving 39 induced. A full 78-element affine action sends the explicit essential cycle to all 39 induced cycles. Their winding classes in Z² fall into three 13-element translation orbits and have a determinant-one pair, proving primitivity and integral generation. Exact standalone exhaustive checks rerun successfully on actual files and match the saved output.

value.rationale: The first flag member of the classical cyclic-torus family is a natural canonical graph complex. Its shortest integral loops exhibit three symmetry-balanced primitive directions, versus one direction in the related published n>=17 family theorem. A complete all-simple-carrier count and spanning lattice property are not determined by homotopy type or Betti numbers; they provide a precise benchmark for combinatorial systolic geometry of flag surfaces.
